'''Valland''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] agent of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] she was stationed at the [[Alien Outreach Center]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="TOR" />
